description_excerpt: Job Description Support the Calibration Manager in developing and executing business development strategies for calibration services and IoT environmental real-time monitoring solutions. Identify and develop opportunities within target industries including: • Semiconductor Manufacturing • Pharmaceutical & Life Sciences • Hospitals & Healthcare • Automotive & Electric Vehicle Manufacturing Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers, including Engineering Managers, Facility Managers, QA/QC Managers, Validation Managers, EHS Managers, Reliability Engineers, Metrology Engineers,…
